plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 12th house: they bring up your hidden fears and old patterns - sometimes healing, sometimes a heavy restriction you can't quite name. Failure mode: a quiet sense of being limited or burdened with no clear source. Do the inner work together; name the unspoken weight.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
